lines.text: Many learners say: I was tired, so went to bed.
Better: I was tired, so I went to bed.
Each part needs a subject, like I.
I ate! I was hungry, so I ate lunch.

data.wrong: I was tired, so went to bed.
data.right: I was tired, so I went to bed.
data.why: Each part needs a subject, like I.

native.tip: En español “estaba cansado, así que me fui” no necesita “yo”, pero en inglés siempre va “I.”
native.caption: Muchos dicen “I was tired, so went to bed.” 🙈 En español no hace falta decir “yo”, pero en inglés cada frase necesita su sujeto: “I was tired, so I went to bed.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.tip: In Spanish you can drop “yo”, but in English every sentence needs a subject like “I.”
